channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: I'm a senior lawyer and only work 25 hours a week. I wanted to be present for my kids.
item.description: Maddi Thimont explains how she became a general counsel working 25 hours a week, balancing a senior legal career with parenting.

item.title: My rare plants sell for five figures. The business helps me support my extended family, but I work about 100 hours a week.
item.description: Harry Luu explains how he left academia to build a business selling rare plants, supporting a family of eight through data-driven decisions.

item.title: AI job listings surge to a record, even as broader hiring slows
item.description: The divergent data raises a big question: Can AI carry the labor market in 2026?

item.title: Amazon's $8 billion Anthropic investment balloons to $61 billion
item.description: The cloud giant holds convertible notes in Anthropic. As the AI startup raises more money, this debt converts to equity.

item.title: The DOJ says it took down over 9,500 of the Epstein files
item.description: The files contained victim-identifying information and needed to be further redacted, DOJ officials said.

item.title: How AI is helping these solopreneurs build more personal membership communities — with less work
item.description: AI empowers solopreneurs Gabriela Fiorentino, Clara Ma, and Lis Best to enhance community support by reducing operational load.

item.title: Details you missed in the 2026 Winter Olympics opening ceremony
item.description: The 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics began with an opening ceremony featuring symbolic outfits and nods to the host country of Italy.

item.title: Taylor Swift's latest business move is another attempt to hack the charts — and it'll probably work
item.description: Taylor Swift is temporarily withholding the "Opalite" music video from YouTube. The unconventional move is a reaction to new Billboard chart rules.

item.title: Saab is looking to arm its Gripen fighter jets with a proven drone-killing rocket after studying the Ukraine war
item.description: The fighter, built for war with Russia, is set to be one of the three main pillars of Ukraine's future air force.

item.title: Lasers, jammer guns, and mobile turrets at Asia's biggest aviation event show how the counter-drone craze is taking hold
item.description: At Singapore's biennial airshow, quadcopters and laser turrets featured alongside the usual fighter jets and passenger planes.
